name: edge-observatory
description: Cloudflare-native analytics with transactional event receipts and native SQLite reporting

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/tracker && npm run build -w apps/web && node scripts/assemble-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/worker -w apps/query -w apps/web -w packages/tracker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/worker -w apps/query -w apps/web
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w apps/query && npm run deploy -w apps/worker
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:integration && npm test && npm run test:runtime && npm run build && npm run build:worker
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply qwa --local -c wrangler.local.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/local
scripts.seed:local: wrangler d1 execute qwa --local -c wrangler.local.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/local --file scripts/local-seed.sql
